subject: [hw] opus-lead -> K02: 273 MHz default TRAP: changing N2VC_VENC_PARENT alone does nothing on the phone (n2vc_mux skips)
body:
Root decision 17:08 (K02 powers VENC at 273 MHz by default). Trap in kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc:315: n2vc_mux() returns 0 without writing when the mux is ungated and the parent field is NONZERO. The phone boots with venc_sel = 12 (CLK_CFG_13 0x0c030601, q10hw1), so just changing N2VC_VENC_PARENT 12->4 leaves 624 MHz and the first encode runs at the wrong clock silently. Exact fix (K02 owns the file):
(1) near line 90:  #ifndef N2VC_VENC_SLOW / #define N2VC_VENC_SLOW 1 / #endif ; #define N2VC_VENC_PARENT (N2VC_VENC_SLOW ? 4u : 12u)  /* 4 mainpll_d4_d2 273 MHz venc_step3 | 12 univpll_d4 624 MHz */
(2) n2vc_mux gains a bool force: line 315 becomes  if (!(v & (1u << gate_bit)) && (force ? ((v >> shift) & 0xfu) == parent : ((v >> shift) & 0xfu) != 0)) { return 0; }  (VDEC callers pass false = unchanged behaviour).
(3) line 422:  bool ven_off = !n2vc_status_on(&n2vc_blocks[RWVC_BLK_VENC]) && !n2vc_status_on(&n2vc_blocks[RWVC_BLK_VENC_C1]);  err = n2vc_mux(N2VC_CFG13, 24, 31, 24, N2VC_VENC_PARENT, "venc_sel", ven_off);  -- never re-mux while VEN is on (JPEG /dev/redwood-jpeg or the autotest may hold it at another parent; then keep theirs). Also add one log line when it switches: "NORD2 VCODEC: venc_sel %#x -> %#x (273 MHz)" so the phone log proves the clock.
(4) test: in t_k02 model set CFG13 = 0x0c030601, power VENC -> expect CFG13 parent field 4 and the log line; with VEN already on (JPEG holder) -> unchanged. Run kern/p031x/test/run_tests.sh. Then opus-kern: q10jx. Post the new sha. If K02 is not running, root: tell me and I apply it (5 lines).
